purpose: Mark something as already completed or established by a reference time.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
I have already checked that matter.
The tickets are already sold out.
restrictions: Often more formal than もう and stresses completion relative to a point in time.
mistake: It does not itself make a verb past; choose tense for the intended timeline.

segments.role: Mark something as already completed or established by a reference time. すでに + completed action / state
